summary: Robert Evans, Katy Stoll and Cody Johnston react to the July 2019 CNN Democratic primary debates, criticising the moderators' framing, Joe Biden's performance, Marianne Williamson's grift and Tulsi Gabbard's record.

evidence.note: Host says this is not a BtB episode but a prelude to the hosts' upcoming election-year podcast
Long segment on Williamson as a populist grifter and her ironic right-wing fan base
Hosts argue CNN moderators framed questions against Sanders and used Republican talking points
Gabbard attacks Harris's prosecutorial record; hosts discuss Gabbard's Assad visit
Several minutes on candidates' immigration positions, child detention and decriminalisation
Protesters chant about the Eric Garner officer; de Blasio and Gillibrand responses
Inslee's climate message praised; moderators interrupt climate answers

notes: Promo for the hosts' election podcast (later Worst Year Ever), described on air as not a BtB episode, so crossover beats current-affairs by precedence. No single bastard; the debate night is the primary subject. Detroit venue is from general knowledge, not the transcript. Climate theme is borderline in airtime.
